text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, all done! Ehehe, I'm glad I made it in time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan's I'll hand over later, but as for the others...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I really hope they like them.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Teio-san, Kita-san, what did you two wish—wait, are we not supposed to ask that kind of thing?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mine was "I'm gonna win this year too!" It's less of a wish and more of a declaration, though!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oohh, as expected of you, Teio-san! Kita-san, do you think so to—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: U-Um, excuse me!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hyah?! W-What's the matter? Are you hungry?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
N-No. Actually, um...
...H-Here! There's something I want to give to both of you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What Kitasan Black built up the courage to hold out was—two small handmade charms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Upon receiving them, it was clear they were handmade. Though the stitching was exposed and clumsy, they were charms brimming with heartfelt feelings.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not very good at sewing, but... I made them with all my heart!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Good health, traffic safety, and, um... I tried to pour all sorts of wishes into them.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted to give them to the people precious to me, so I made a bunch, but... I just couldn't get any better at making them.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Kita-san... are you sure you want to give one to me too? Receiving something made with so much care...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Of course! Seeing you always giving your absolute all gives me so much energy, Spe-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuu! Kita-san, I... tomorrow, the day after, and forever on, I'll stay super energetic for you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thanks for mine too, it's super cute! It totally feels like your feelings are packed inside. Looks like it'll bring great fortune♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I want you to stay strong and cool forever, Teio-san...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm so glad I gave them to you. They're kind of clumsy, so I was worried you might not accept them!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Not at all! Ah... but... Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you bet! Let's go, Kita-chan! To buy your charm!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?! F-For me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We can't give you a handmade charm in return, but... we'll pick one out with all our heart!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: We want you to stay strong and healthy too, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I caught sight of the two pulling Kitasan Black by the hand as they ran to buy a charm. It was a truly heartwarming scene.
